item.text:
ResStock **includes high-rise apartment buildings, but excludes dormitories and assisted care facilities**.

| Building type | Included? |
|---|---|
| Dormitories | No |
| Assisted care facilities | No |
| High-rise apartment buildings | Yes |

ResStock follows the U.S. Energy Information Administration’s definition of a *housing unit*. This excludes congregate housing such as dormitories, prisons, and assisted care facilities, but includes high-rise multifamily housing—even when building codes classify it as commercial. See Section 5 of the [ResStock Technical Reference](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf).
